entries.title: Psalms 73:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> Truly God is good to Israel, to such as are of a pure heart.

entries.title: Psalms 73:2
segments: But as for me, my feet were almost gone, my steps had well nigh slipped;

entries.title: Psalms 73:3
segments: For I was envious at the arrogant, seeing the prosperity of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 73:4
segments: For they have no pangs in their death, and their body is well nourished;

entries.title: Psalms 73:5
segments: They have not the hardships of mankind, neither are they plagued like [other] men:

entries.title: Psalms 73:6
segments: Therefore pride encompasseth them as a neck-chain, violence covereth them [as] a garment;

entries.title: Psalms 73:7
segments: Their eyes stand out from fatness, they exceed the imaginations of their heart:

entries.title: Psalms 73:8
segments: They mock and speak wickedly of oppression, they speak loftily:

entries.title: Psalms 73:9
segments: They set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 73:10
segments: Therefore his people turn hither, and waters in fulness are wrung out to them.

entries.title: Psalms 73:11
segments: And they say, How can *God know, and is there knowledge in the Most High?

entries.title: Psalms 73:12
segments: Behold, these are the wicked, and they prosper in the world: they heap up riches.

entries.title: Psalms 73:13
segments: Truly have I purified my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency:

entries.title: Psalms 73:14
segments: For all the day have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

entries.title: Psalms 73:15
segments: ¶If I said, I will speak thus, behold, I should be faithless to the generation of thy children.

entries.title: Psalms 73:16
segments: When I thought to be able to know this, it was a grievous task in mine eyes;

entries.title: Psalms 73:17
segments: Until I went into the sanctuaries of *God; [then] understood I their end.

entries.title: Psalms 73:18
segments: Truly thou settest them in slippery places, thou castest them down in ruins.

entries.title: Psalms 73:19
segments: How are they suddenly made desolate! they pass away, consumed with terrors.

entries.title: Psalms 73:20
segments: As a dream, when one awaketh, wilt thou, Lord, on arising despise their image.

entries.title: Psalms 73:21
segments: ¶When my heart was in a ferment, and I was pricked in my reins,

entries.title: Psalms 73:22
segments: Then I was brutish and knew nothing; I was [as] a beast with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 73:23
segments: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden my right hand;

entries.title: Psalms 73:24
segments: Thou wilt guide me by thy counsel, and after the glory, thou wilt receive me.

entries.title: Psalms 73:25
segments: Whom have I in the heavens? and there is none upon earth I desire beside thee.

entries.title: Psalms 73:26
segments: My flesh and my heart faileth: God is the rock of my heart and my portion for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 73:27
segments: For behold, they that are far from thee shall perish; thou destroyest every one that goeth a whoring from thee.

entries.title: Psalms 73:28
segments: But as for me, it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord Jehovah, that I may declare all thy works.
